scientific_integrity: Analytic unique-root proof and strict comparative statics; 91,091 deterministic numerical checks supplement but do not certify an infinite domain. Priority remains provisional against general age-replacement and forest rotation literature. No empirical validation or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact idealized single-cohort expected viable seed release divided by expected time. No population persistence or planting success inferred. Constant wildfire hazard, deterministic seed-maturation age, exponential viability loss, instantaneous complete seed release at either fire, no seasonality, stand mortality, fuel changes, fire-intensity effect or repeat-cohort guarantee.
title: A wildfire-hazard reversal in the optimal fire deadline for maturing canopy seed banks
